catholic-encyclopedia-1913-archbishop: A 1913 entry on the archbishop — the metropolitan of the province. Sebastian Messmer sets out his rights and duties. He crowns the province's bishops. The pallium marks his rank. The Church's regional shepherd. His cross is borne before him. His throne crowns the metropolitan church.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-auxiliary-bis: A 1913 entry on the auxiliary bishop — the helper of the diocesan. P.M.J. Rock explains his useful office. He bears the burden with his chief. The great sees need their aides. The bishop's right hand. His title is a vanished see.
